title: VMix GPU tilt budget planner — staged procurement & utilization simulator
content:
Purpose: quick, portable workbook to explore mixed-GPU (VMix) procurement strategies across regions for Private/VPC customers. Focus: minimize up-front capital while meeting 99th-percentile latency targets and a 72% target utilization for steady-state. This sheet is intentionally informal — working assumptions, scenario toggles, and a recommended baseline for procurement discussions with finance and sourcing.

Summary of approach:
- Treat GPUs as a portfolio: high-perf (H100), mid-perf (A100-80), efficient-inference (L40S/Trn-eq) and spot/lease lanes.
- Allow "tilt" factor per region: a percent bias that shifts workload to cheaper SKUs when latency budget allows. Example: US-west tilt 0.7 favors H100, EU-central tilt 1.3 biases toward A100/Refurb H100s.
- Model waves: Wave 0 (pilot) covers 10% baseline burst for onboarding customers; Wave 1 covers 50% expected year-1 steady load; Wave 2 + Wave 3 are procurement tranches tied to utilization triggers (70% and 85%).
- Include lease vs purchase split (default 30% lease for first 12 months), and refurbishment exchange program (trade-in credits starting month 18).

Key knobs (cells to edit):
- target_latency_p99_ms = 250
- tokens_per_second_per_gpu = {H100: 18000, A100-80: 9500, L40S: 4200}  -- measured for our model mix (gpt-like transformers with kv-cache usage)
- avg_request_tokens = 80
- concurrency_headroom = 1.25  (allows for spiky arrivals + batching inefficiency)
- utilization_target = 0.72
- safety_buffer = 0.15 (fraction of additional capacity for failures/maintenance)
- lease_fraction_wave0 = 0.5; lease_fraction_wave1 = 0.3

Example micro-scenario (US-west primary):
Inputs:
- expected_qps_workload_equivalent_at_80t = 12,500 requests/min (~7.5M tokens/min)
- avg_tokens_per_request = 80
- working_model_profile = 70% gen heavy, 30% embed/rerank (affects tokens_per_second assumptions)

Derived calculations (one-line formulas):
- tokens_per_minute_needed = qps * avg_tokens = 12,500 * 80 = 1,000,000 tokens/min
- tokens_per_minute_per_gpu = tokens_per_second_per_gpu * 60 * utilization_target = (H100: 18000*60*0.72 = 777,600 tokens/min)
- nominal_gpus_needed_before_buffer = ceil(tokens_needed / tokens_per_minute_per_gpu)  => for H100 alone = ceil(1,000,000 / 777,600) = 2 (but this ignores concurrency headroom)
- adjust_for_concurrency_and_headroom = nominal_gpus * concurrency_headroom => 2 * 1.25 = 2.5 => round up to 3 physical GPUs
- add_safety_buffer => 3 * (1 + safety_buffer) = 3.45 => round up to 4 GPUs for US-west pilot if only H100s used

BUT: VMix allocation shows cheaper mix reduces cost while keeping latency SLOs:
- mixed allocation baseline for same tokens (heuristic): 40% H100, 40% A100-80, 20% L40S (tilt factor will shift this).
- convert tokens capacity into discrete nodes and racks using per-node GPU counts (example node: 8xH100, 4xA100-80, or 8xL40S depending on SKU family).

BOM estimator (spreadsheet-style lines, editable):
- SKU | unit_gpu | per_unit_price_USD | units_per_node | rack_u_per_node | est_power_draw_w | notes
- H100-80GB | GPU | 58,000 | 8 | 4U | 3200W | typical dense training blades or HGX; includes conservative freight
- A100-80GB | GPU | 20,000 | 4 | 2U | 1600W | refurbished market median price used in scenarios
- L40S | GPU | 10,500 | 8 | 2U | 1100W | inference-optimized, cheaper power
- Server-node (chassis) | node | 6,800 | n/a | rack_u_per_node | 400W overhead | rail kit, warranty baseline
- Network ToR (100Gbps equivalency) | per-tor | 12,000 | per 2 racks | 1U | 800W | includes redundant PSUs
- PDU / PDCapacity / Cooling | per-rack | 6,000 | per rack | 0U | see power calc | includes raised-floor conversion capex where needed
- Spare GPU pool (exchange program) | pool | 1,500 per GPU/year | variable | n/a | reserved for hot-swap

CapEx estimate subtotal examples (Wave 1 baseline, US-west):
- assume final allocated GPUs (post-tilt & headroom) = H100: 12, A100: 20, L40S: 6 => raw GPU price = 12*58k + 20*20k + 6*10.5k = 696k + 400k + 63k = 1,159k
- nodes/chassis and rack overhead add ~18% => +208k => hardware subtotal ~1.37M
- shipping, customs, setup and 1-year hardware maintenance ~9% => +123k => total Wave1 CapEx ~1.5M

Lease/Opex scenario:
- Typical lease rate used: 7% monthly (example) for 12-month term of leased units. Wave0 uses 50% lease to accelerate onboarding. Compare blended monthly cost for lease vs purchase amortization (5-year straight-line + maintenance).

Power & DC run-rate estimates (monthly):
- power_cost_per_kwh = $0.11 (variable by region)
- monthly_power_draw_kwh = total_watts_racked * 24 * 30 / 1000
- example: 8 H100 nodes at 3200W = 25.6kW => monthly_kwh ~ 18,432 => monthly_power_cost ~ $2,027

Region split & tilt: sample table (editable)
- US-west: tilt=0.9; target mix H100 45%, A100 35%, L40S 20%; procurement waves = [10%, 50%, 40%]
- EU-central: tilt=1.2; target mix H100 30%, A100 50%, L40S 20%; procurement waves = [15%, 45%, 40%]
- AP-south: tilt=1.6; target mix H100 20%, A100 60%, L40S 20%; higher refurb and lease fraction assumed

Procurement timeline (recommended):
- Week 0: sign lease for 50% of pilot capacity; bring 8-12 GPUs online for validation (Wave0)
- Month 3: place Wave1 purchase order (cover 40–60% of Year1 steady-state) with 16–20 week lead time
- Month 9: evaluate utilization triggers and commit Wave2 if utilization > 70% for rolling 6 weeks
- Month 15: trade-in/refurb program option opens, reallocate credits towards Wave3 or shift to higher-efficiency SKUs

Risk notes & mitigations (short):
- Lead-time volatility: keep a 10–14 week lease buffer for critical regions; include clause for staggered shipments
- Price volatility (GPU): run monthly price-scan in procurement scripts (linked artifact) and refresh tilt when delta > 12%
- Power/cooling surprises: model incremental PUE delta of +0.12 for dense racks; run a thermal soak test during Wave0

Next actions & asks for sourcing/finance:
- Validate refurbished A100 price band from supplier list (target $18k–$22k for usable 80GB boards) — @Diego
- Confirm tax/tariff impact for EU shipments (expected +3.5% capex) — @Sofia
- Run a sensitivity sweep in the attached simulation (sheet tabs): +/- 10% tokens/sec and +/- 20% GPU price

Notes to self (rough):
- I prefer modeling nodes as homogeneous families for rack planning, then map mixed GPU counts to node types in a second pass (avoids oddball chassis fits).
- Keep spare-pool as a percentage of total GPUs (default 6%) and track hot-swap SLA implications in SRE runbooks.

Revision history:
- 2026-02-10 created as pilot workbook by Asha
- 2026-02-22 incorporated refurbished pricing and lease scenario (Diego)
- 2026-03-02 updated tilt defaults after initial cost-scan (Sofia)

Unresolved questions:
- Do we want to include TPU/accelerator alternatives for specific inference workloads? (pros/cons: cost vs latency determinism)
- Should we codify minimum order quantities per supplier into the waves? (affects upfront cash commitments)

Attachments (sheet tabs expected):
- Assumptions (editable knobs)
- By-region calculator (tiles per region)
- BOM & Rack mapping
- Lease vs Purchase cashflow pro forma
- Sensitivity sweeps

End of doc — this is intentionally a working sheet to iterate with Sourcing and Finance. Use linked PR and Confluence page for canonical procurement templates.
